BUILD: standalone `lean -j1 -o <olean> <file>` (same driver as _s1909_compile.ps1), EXIT=0, 26s.
AXIOMS: only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound (#print axioms for all 18 main items; no sorryAx).

WHAT IS PROVED (all unconditional):
  S1943EssSurj : S1878EssSurj
  S1943Functor_isEquivalence : S1878Functor.IsEquivalence
  S1943FunctorToSlice_isEquivalence : S1878FunctorToSlice.IsEquivalence
  S1943ModelEssSurj : S1897ModelEssSurj
  S1943Strong (C) : StrongEtaleStackFiniteEtaleMorphism (S1897ExtMap C)  -- for every C : S1816Target

HOW (no fake 2-cell/iso, no new hypothesis):
(a) For C and a point q : y(T) -> y(Spec R'), 2-Yoneda (S1742) gives q~ := S1742HomOfStrongTrans q.
    Take the honest scheme fibre product P := T x_{Spec R'} C.carrier of (C -> Spec R') and q~
    in Over (Spec F') (S1943PbOver/PbFst/PbSnd, IsPullback from Limits.pullback).
    The square of representable stacks is 2-commutative *proved*, not assumed: the comparison
    2-cell is the 2-Yoneda comparison of the strict scheme-square equality (S1943PbCommutes).
    S1911RepresentableTwoPullbackPullbackSquare then yields a TwoPullbackWitness + full 2-universal
    property (S1943StackWitness).  Transporting along e : y(q~) ~= q (S1756WhiskerLeftIso on the
    comparison, cones transported back for the witness) gives the presentation at the *arbitrary*
    point q (S1943MovedPresentation/S1943MovedConeEssSurj), hence S1943BaseChange.
    Finiteness/etaleness of the projection: FiniteEtaleCover.finiteEtale_pullback (S1943HasProperty).
(b) CoherentCover.ofStrong of that strong structure (via S1897ExtCoherent).  The identity-point model
    is pullback.snd (C -> Spec R') id; `pullback f 1 ~= X` (S1943PullbackAlongIdIso) plus Over.isoMk
    gives S1816Obj A ~= C (S1943S1816Obj_iso) => S1878EssSurj.

NEGATIVE / SCOPE:
  * S1897's literal S1897ExtensionData.idPresentation equality is NOT used and NOT proved;
    S1897FirstMissing (literal form) remains unproved and is now unnecessary.
  * Nothing here is the false literal S1897RepresentableTwoPullback; only S1911's pullback-square form.
  * No statement of S1897/S1878/S1852 was weakened or changed; no existing definition modified.

LEDGER: appended a result entry to AUDIT_LEDGER.md (append-only). coord/queue.md + coord/STATE.md
were NOT modified (no S1943 node existed; I left integration bookkeeping to you to avoid clobbering
concurrent agents). Probe files _S1943*.lean were removed; build helper _s1943_build.ps1 kept.

CAVEAT: this is a standalone `lean` build of a tmp/ file, not a `lake build` of the project;
the file imports only tmp.sheaf.xif.paper.S1911RepresentableTwoPullbackActual (olean fresh, 16:05).
